function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a UTF-8 text file inside the repository. Use before changing code; do not read secrets or generated build output.

function.name: search_code
function.description: Search Java, Kotlin, XML and properties files for a literal string or regular expression. Read-only.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Create or replace a file inside the repository. Prefer apply_patch for existing files. Never write outside the repository or into .git.

function.name: apply_patch
function.description: Apply a unified diff to the repository. The patch must apply cleanly to the current working tree. Use for multi-file changes.

patch.description: Unified diff starting with diff --git or ---/+++ headers.

function.name: run_maven
function.description: Run a bounded Maven goal in the project. Use test or verify after changes. Never use this to install arbitrary software or run shell commands.

module.description: Optional Maven module path, e.g. services/orders.

function.name: arch_check
function.description: Run the project's ArchUnit architecture tests. Use after refactors that change package boundaries or dependencies.

function.name: git_diff
function.description: Show the current uncommitted diff. Read-only; use before summarizing changes.
